$Comment: Christmas Carols, the carol tour: once in each run of Christmas, sing a carol to people around the
Forgotten Temple, then tell Santa. The step counts a talk credit carrying the Qualifier
Christmas_Carol, which only the carol line gives (DialogueExtensions/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Carol.json):
that line shows in every other character's conversation all Christmas, and each character can be sung
to once a day. No Target means whoever the player is talking to. Npc.TurnInId, from the base, adds the
report-back step to Santa once enough people have heard a carol. It opens once Santa's first quest is
Listing.MainLine is false here: the tour is a side errand, so it reads as a side quest while the story
Repeat.PerRun brings it back once in each run of Christmas: a run pays it once, a forced or moved run
cannot pay it twice, and a tour left unfinished when the run ends waits for the next one with its
carols kept. It pays through Christmas_Carols_Pay, with favor on Santa's Nice List and Festival Favor
on its own Rewards. The achievement Carol Singer counts it.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Acrobatics XP for the walk about the temple, waiting to be
collected with the rest. The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a
server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Carols
